_about: Golden cases for what a device does with an application message it cannot open, and for the resent lane frame.
Resent lane frames: docs/sealed-messages.md §Asking for a message again.
`hints` are the four hint values a sender writes into the message's MLS authenticated data. `placeholderGraceMs` is how long a resendable loss stays hidden while its ask is out.

Each `fates` case is one unopenable message: `hint` is what its authenticated data said, or null for none (or a value the reader does not know). `fate` is `show` (a placeholder now, no ask), `ask` (hidden, asked for, shown after the grace if no answer comes) or `drop` (counted, nothing shown). For an `ask`, `transcript` says whether the held entry waits for a resent transcript message (true) or a resent lane frame (false).
`urgent` gives the SendSealed urgent bit each hint sends with: derived from the hint and nothing else (docs/delivery.md §Sending).

`retryKey` cases give a transcript send's `client_message_id`: HMAC-SHA256 under the sending install's own 32-byte secret over `label` then the frame id, its first 16 bytes shaped as a version-4 UUID. A reader who holds the frame id cannot make it.

`sendLog` holds the author's send-log constants (`maxAgeMs`, `cap`) and `until` cases: a frame sent at `sentAtMs` into a conversation whose timer is `timerSeconds` (0: none) can no longer be answered from `untilMs`.
`resendFrames` are wire strings of the `resend-frame` answer and what a reader makes of each: the parsed fields, or null for one it must ignore.
To replay: run each case through your own implementation of the format and compare the result with the case's expectation, field by field.

fates.name: a call record says show it now
a message is asked for, as a transcript message
a reaction, edit or delete is asked for, as a lane frame
a hint this build does not know is dropped

urgent.name: a receipt, resend, history share or group event

cases.name: a frame id under one install's secret
the same frame id under another install's secret

until.name: a one-hour timer cuts it short
a four-week timer does not stretch it

resendFrames.name: an answer may not carry an ask
an answer may not carry another answer
a newer version is not this one
a frame that is not a lane frame
